auditor: independent reused restore_contract_audit subagent; read-only original media inspection
coverage: JSON/SQLite x source/plain Node lib x company/laboratory
Real complete authored warm Agent/tool/Team/Session workflow, not fabricated fixtures
Every fault independently derived from its actual seed and compared with every authoritative WAL row and Session file hash
Selected initial checkpoint precedes canonical hire/representative identities; current whole suffix remains retained
Saved before/after Native WAL agrees with actual raw medium and remains identical across rejected restore
Bad Session/header/descriptor/invitation/Envelope/Persona/implementation pin remains damaged after refusal
cacheDifferencePolicy: Only storage-log checkpoint/summary projections excluded from authoritative delta comparison; every such difference individually indexed. No HMR fixture mutation is used.

archive.initialOutcome: 31 failures / 33 passes; ENOSPC retained, not included as successful matrix cases

limitations: No claim of final-release input freeze: this audit inspects observed artifacts and current verifier/mutator only; parent captures final inputs separately.
Keyless scripted LlmAdapter is real Agent/tool flow, not a real external model/provider acceptance.
Implementation-generation corruption changes all matching hiring Native pins, including frozen definitions/manifests; it is not an isolated representative-generation-2 test.
Missing Participant fault renames its real durable Participant snapshots, leaving canonical activation references invalid; no synthetic provider wrapper substitutes for actual medium damage.
Cross-owner faults acquire a Native handle (writableOpen=1) but refuse before Team attach and leave the Native WAL unchanged; Persona/implementation faults refuse before Native open.
No new SIGKILL/random sampling/external-system side-effect or GUI/SDK wheel validation is claimed.
